strings.subtitle: — Sesenyi sa difaele —
strings.no_file: Ga go faele yeo e kgethilwego
strings.dnd_unavailable: Go hula le go tlogela ga go hwetšagale. Šomiša konopo yeo e lego ka tlase.
strings.ft_lnk: Tsela ye kopana (.lnk) — e tla ganywa
strings.strategy_full: ☢  WO TLALETŠEGO — ka moka ka lefela (e bolokegilego)
strings.ssd_warning:
Temoso! Go SSD, mokgwa wa go ngwala godimo ga o netefatše go senyega ka ntlha ya TRIM.
Lenaneo le ke la HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faele "{name}" e tla ngwalwa godimo gomme e phumolwe.

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Ye ke sekgotla-tšwelopele (.lnk). Ke sekgotla-tšwelopele feela se tla senywa.

Faele yeo e e supago e tla dula e bolokegile.

Tšwela pele?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Ye ke draefe ya neteweke (\\server\share).
Go ngwala godimo ga dikarolo ga go garantie go senywa — sefaere se ka ba le disnapšoto, deduplication goba CoW.

Tšwela pele?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Ye ke draefe ye e tlošwago (USB / HDD ya ka ntle).
Molaodi o ka boloka dipoloko tša kgale ka polokelong.

Tšwela pele?
strings.dont_ask_again: O se ke wa botšiša gape
strings.dont_show_again: O se ke wa bontšha gape
strings.error_cannot_read:
Ga e kgone go bala faele:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FAELE E NGWADILWE GODIMO GOM ME E PHUMOLWE
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mela ya datha ye mengwe (ADS) ga e šome.
• Kuranta ya USN ga e hlwekiswe.
• Dikopi tša moriti le dikgokagano tša maru
  (OneDrive bj.bj.) ga di amege.
strings.status_full: Diteng ka moka di ngwadilwe godimo ka lefela. Go boa ga go kgonege — didirišwa di tla bona lefela fela.
strings.status_fast: Hlogo, moela le mela ya 4 MB di ngwadilwe godimo. Tše dingwe ga se tša amega, eupša ka ntlha ya dikgala, go boa ka moka ka didirišwa tša moreki ga go kgonege. Go ditokumente tša sephiri šomiša MOKGWA WO TLALETŠEGO.
strings.status_empty: Faele e be e le lefela, go ngwala godimo ga go a hlokege. E phumotšwe.
strings.error_permission: Ga e kgone go fihlela faele. E ka ba e butšwe ka lenaneong le lengwe. E tswalele gomme o leke gape.
strings.error_not_found: Faele ga se ya hwetšwa. E ka ba e phumotšwe.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ye ke link ya seswantšho. Dikgokagano ga di kgone go senywa — faele yeo e e supago e tla dula e bolokegile.
strings.error_reparse: Ye ke faele ya seboloki (OneDrive goba e swanago). Datha ya yona e bolokilwe ka leru, e sego ka disikeng — ga go na seo se ka senywago mo.
strings.error_not_file: Ye ga se faele (foldara goba se sengwe). Go gogela faele.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faele ye e na le hard link tše dingwe ({n} ka moka). Hard link ga di na ya pele — maina ka moka a a swana. Ge o ka senya ka tsela ya bjale, datha e tla ngwalwa godimo gomme ya kgaolwa go 32 bytes, eupša mašaledi a tla dula a fihlelega ka dikgokagano tše dingwe. Phumola dikgokagano ka moka pele.
strings.error_compressed:
Faele e kgateletšwe, e šireletšitšwe goba e sparse. Go ngwala ka zero ga go garantie go senywa ga datha ya kgale ka lebaka la gore NTFS e e boloka ka tsela ye e fapanego.

Tloša seka: tobetsa ka letsogong la go ja → Dipharephare → Ya godimo → tloša letšhwao la 'Kgatela' le/goba 'Šireletša'. Ka morago baka SHREDDER gape.
strings.queue_title: MOKGWA WA GO PHUMOLA KA BONTŠI
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Go ema ka morago ga faele ya bjale...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Difaele tše {count} di tla senywa.
Bogolo ka moka: {size}.

Lekola lenane pele o tšwela pele.
Kgato ye ga e kgone go bušetšwa morago.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Tloša difaele ka moka tše {count} go tšwa moleng?

Difaele ka botšona DI KA SE amegwe — ke lenane feela.
strings.hardlink_text:
Faele "{name}" e na le hard link tše dingwe ({nlink} ka moka).

Datha e tla senywa bakeng sa maina ka moka.
Eupša mašaledi (32 bytes) a tla dula ka tlase ga maina a mangwe ka foldareng.

O ka nna wa swanelwa ke go phumola mašaledi ye ka seatla.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Šomiša go hard link ka moka mo moleng
